_comment: Shaman en-Kor's {1}{W} source pull, design step 9 (docs/design/damage-reflection-pipeline.md 4.3 / 10 / 14).
Shaman en-Kor + Stuffy Doll (chosen the opponent) + four opponent Spirits = 6 creatures, so Blasphemous Act
costs {2}{R}; five lands leave exactly one {1}{W}. The Act deals 13 to each creature. The pull (searched on the
damage pipeline's pin stream, paid at the sweep) moves one Spirit's 13 onto the Shaman; the Shaman's free {0}
shields then move all 26 on to the Doll, which is dealt 13 + 26 = 39 as ONE event and reflects 39 -- exactly
the opponent's life. Step 8 alone (the shields, no pull) reflects only 26 and the Doll's once-a-turn ping
cannot close the gap by turn 6: see the _control scenario (a Nomads en-Kor, shields only, in the Shaman's seat).
